meta.name: voice-cloning
meta.description: Local text-to-speech and voice cloning using free, open-source tools. Use when you need to generate speech audio, clone voices, or create voiceovers without paid APIs. Supports Coqui TTS, Bark, and Piper for high-quality local synthesis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用免费开源工具生成语音和克隆声音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要本地生成语音或克隆声音而不依赖付费API
copy.tagline_en: Generate speech and clone voices with free open-source tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need local speech generation or voice cloning without paid APIs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用本地工具将文字转为语音、克隆声音或生成配音，无需付费 API。
howto.when: 当你需要生成语音音频、克隆声音或制作配音，且希望使用免费开源工具时触发。

say.text: 请用 Coqui TTS 把这句话转成语音：你好，世界。
克隆这个音频样本的声音，并说出“今天天气真好”。
say.note: 需要提供 6 秒以上的干净样本

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use local tools to convert text to speech, clone voices, or create voiceovers without paid APIs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to generate speech audio, clone voices, or create voiceovers using free, open-source tools.

say_en.text: Use Coqui TTS to convert this text to speech: Hello, world.
Clone the voice from this audio sample and say 'The weather is nice today.'
